scope: Bounded failure-only legalization using complete selected child-face reservations. A general mixed-face capability improvement; not a newly qualified smaller carrier or fabrication approval.

implementation.input: Optional complete child reservation vectors accompany each primary body. Absent is unknown, not empty. Validate finite geometry/halos, positive dimensions, masks and agreement with the complete occupied-face union.
implementation.search: Retain all existing conservative strategies and successful incumbents. After they fail, at most one additional composer solve uses actual entity projection bounds for opposite-primary-face pairs. Relevant movable pairs only; logical keepouts and wider wiring-channel requirements retain conservative separation.
implementation.projection: An origin-separation bound minus primary width/height is a signed relative-entity adjustment, not a negative physical clearance. RepairSep marks this explicitly; ordinary negative flipped gaps and all nonfinite flipped gaps still reject. Directional fanout and axis-specific offsets are transported through repair flips.
implementation.numerical_acceptance: Raw local offsets propose linear bounds only. Final global child positions execute the existing occupancy 4-decimal quantization and exact pairs_hold check, in addition to hard terms, board constraints, output-grid checks and caller physical validation. No acceptance epsilon or clearance waiver is added.
implementation.reuse: Prepare immutable local reservation arrays once per physical retry, not for each pair/axis. Global quantized geometry is rebuilt and accounted at actual final validation.
implementation.accounting: The registered legalize_reservation_retry event records every attempted physical retry before it executes, including rejection. Prior solver work and diagnostics remain in the receipt. No baseline ceilings were raised.

tests.mixed_face_witness: Two 20x20 mm groups interlock on a 25x25 mm board using sparse opposite-face strips. Whole-zone rectangles reject; the physical retry accepts in all four relative directions, both compact and legalize-only modes. Independent exhaustive occupancy checks each result.
adversarial: A full secondary-face obstacle remains infeasible after exactly one physical retry, without publishing a changed pose.
Roomy conservative incumbents return without executing the retry.
Ordinary negative flipped gap rejects; typed signed projection survives an actual flip; nonfinite projection still rejects.
Independent instrumented occupancy function entries match retry receipt counts; actual final child quantization executes.

policy_run.scope_note: Before the final per-solve immutable-array reuse change; policy declarations were unchanged afterward.

finalist_nonregression_screens.configuration_reference: Same qualified carrier/devkit profiler arguments and schematics recorded in 2026-10-11-disjoint-face-legalization.json, two prepared-input runs each.
finalist_nonregression_screens.scope: Construction-only model/PCB-text screens, not full source audits, DRC or new renders. Observer overhead included and OS cache uncontrolled.

carrier.receipts: All receipt/fallback rows exactly match native/build/carrier-face-aware-final-screen.log, two runs each.

limitations: The real smaller carrier still fails coupled-axis repair: HDMI termination/USB-JTAG separations and other fixed obstacles remain incompatible with the selected repair path. This is not a global infeasibility proof. Projection bounds impose a uniform entity-pair order per axis and can conservatively miss interleaved solutions. Whole-group same-primary-face reservations stay intact. No current carrier size improvement or general speedup is claimed; full placement suite time fell from 161.06 to 34.79 s across runs, but that is not a controlled build benchmark. Matched Python comparisons and other goal outcomes remain incomplete.
